sections.description:
No Register & Comments XD Pro is a powerful, lightweight WordPress security plugin that gives you complete control over user registration and comments on your website. Built with modern security practices, it protects your site from spam registrations and unwanted comments while allowing administrators to maintain full control.

🎯 Key Features

Feature
Description

🔒 Block Public Registration
Prevent all public users from creating accounts

👑 Admin User Creation
Administrators can still create users from admin panel

💬 Block Comments
Disable all public commenting on posts and pages

📊 Activity Logs
Track every blocked attempt with IP, URL, and timestamp

🚫 Auto IP Blocking
Automatically block IPs with multiple failed attempts

🔔 Email Notifications
Get alerts when someone tries to register or comment

🎯 Custom Redirect
Send blocked users to any URL you choose

🛡️ REST API Protection
Blocks registration via REST API endpoints

🛒 WooCommerce Support
Disable registration on checkout and my-account pages

🌐 Multisite Compatible
Works with WordPress Multisite installation

🎨 Modern Admin UI
Professional dashboard with real-time statistics

🔐 Secure by Design
Built with WordPress security best practices

sections.installation:
From WordPress Admin

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “No Register & Comments XD”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload no-register-comments-xd.zip
  4. Click Activate Now

After Activation

  1. Go to No Register XD menu in admin sidebar
  2. Configure your settings
  3. View real-time statistics
  4. Monitor activity logs
sections.faq:
Q: Can administrators still create users?

Yes! Administrators can create users from Users → Add New page. Public registration is blocked only for non-admin users.

Q: Will this affect existing users?

No, only new registrations are blocked. Existing users remain unaffected.

Q: Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, it blocks WooCommerce registration on:
– My Account page
– Checkout page
– REST API endpoints

Q: Can I see who tried to register?

Yes, all attempts are logged with:
– IP address
– User agent
– Attempted URL
– Timestamp
– Blocked type (registration/comment)

Q: Can I enable registration again?

Yes, simply uncheck the “Block Registration” option in settings.

Q: Does this plugin work with page builders?

Yes, it works with all major page builders including Elementor, WPBakery, and Gutenberg.

Q: Is my site’s performance affected?

No, the plugin is optimized for performance and uses minimal resources.

Q: Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes, it’s compatible with W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, and others.

Q: Is multisite supported?

Yes, the plugin works with WordPress Multisite installations.

Q: What PHP version is required?

PHP 7.4 or higher. It’s also compatible with PHP 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, and 8.3.
